description: Lists a Substack publication's posts, newest first, up to 100 per call: slug, title, subtitle, date, word count, whether it is paywalled (paid posts print only their free preview), and Substack's one-line description. Accepts a handle (aidanjude), a subdomain (aidanjude.substack.com) or a custom domain. Returns next_cursor when there are more posts; passing it back returns the next 100. Example calls: {"substack":"aidanjude"}; {"substack":"www.example.com","cursor":"c:eyJ..."}.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call, to read further back

substack.description: Substack handle, subdomain or custom domain

name: read_substack_archive
title: Read a Substack's archive: every post's title, date, length and summary
